name: @pimlabs/stilus-mcp
description: MCP server for manuscript QA — inspect, clean, compare, chunk

scripts.bundle: bun build --bundle --target bun src/index.ts --outfile dist/stilus-mcp && printf '#!/usr/bin/env bun\n' | cat - dist/stilus-mcp > dist/stilus-mcp.tmp && mv dist/stilus-mcp.tmp dist/stilus-mcp && chmod +x dist/stilus-mcp
scripts.publish:npm: npm pack && npm publish *.tgz --access public && rm *.tgz && git tag v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git push origin --tags
